title: Retrospective data analysis for pain assessment after colorectal and bariatric surgery
summary: A retrospective analysis of data from 329 patients will be conducted. This includes 268 patients who underwent weight-reduction surgery (bariatric surgery) and 61 patients who underwent bowel surgery (colorectal surgery). Shortly after surgery or on the first postoperative day, patients' pain levels were assessed using the Visual Analog Scale (VAS). Various variables before, during, and after surgery will be collected and analyzed to determine whether there is an association with the occurrence of postoperative pain (VAS ≥ 3).
conditions: Patients with a history of bariatric or colorectal surgery

interventions.name: postoperative patients, who underwent bariatric or colorectal surgery

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Pain VAS≥3
previous surgery (bariatric or colorectal)
included in one of the studies RAPRAS (DRKS00029265) or RAPRAB (DRKS00029078)
Exclusion criteria:
no inclusion in RAPRAS (DRKS00029265) or RAPRAB (DRKS00029078)
